chapter: Hutto 1978-79: NBC, radio and the N'goma drums
title: Radio in the forties: Telephone Hour and Voice of Firestone
summary: He cannot pin down his NBC staff status in the war years but played the Telephone Hour for Don Voorhees and several Voice of Firestone programs.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Okay now, when the war time came in the forties, were you still predominantly in radio? And I know these jingles on the floating tin cans or something....
Well you were still a staff musician at NBC then or...?

You know I'd have to look that up. I really couldn't tell you. But I was with NBC for a hell of a long time. And I don't really remember now because life was going by and I just couldn't remember everything I was connected with.
Were you ever on the Telephone Hour or the Firestone program?
I played the Telephone Hour for Don Voorhees.
You did. And the Voice of Firestone.
And the Voice of Firestone, I played maybe a haf a dozen programs.
Okay, I have a transcriptions of one of those here and we'll work that in too.
